lessons: Translate requirements into explicit phases and error precedence; validate in order before transforming or producing output.
Preserve original positions, boundaries, and bounds throughout parsing and transformation.
Make operations transactional: check all failure conditions before mutating state, logs, or counters.
Model traversal and streaming as ordered state machines; apply each change exactly when encountered.
Test boundary cases, especially where multiple errors, chunks, records, or sequential edits interact.

lessons: Translate specifications into explicit, ordered validation and operation steps; preserve error precedence, deterministic tie-breaks, and observable intermediate failures.
Validate inputs completely before processing or mutating state; make each fallible operation atomic and commit changes only after success.
Model streaming input as a state machine; preserve absolute source offsets and defer only checks that depend on end-of-input.
Preserve source indices, boundaries, and provenance through transformations; apply canonical ordering only when required.
Separate parsing, validation, filtering, ranking, computation, and formatting into clear phases.
Define arithmetic and geometry invariants explicitly; use checked operations and test boundaries, ties, and algebraic identities.
Normalize and validate paths before lookup; traverse prefixes in order and verify the final entry’s type.
Resolve output rules first; distinguish semantic content from presentation separators when validating and formatting.

lessons: Translate specifications into explicit validation order, state transitions, boundaries, and failure precedence before coding; test interactions and tie cases at each boundary.
Validate complete inputs before execution or mutation; separate parsing, validation, evaluation, and mutation to keep errors deterministic.
Preserve original offsets, indices, and shared-base relationships through transformations; report failures against the original input.
Use bounded cursors, explicit limits, and checked arithmetic; validate each layer before consuming data or calculating results.
Represent ordering, interval interactions, and traversal rules explicitly; test tie-breaking and reachability independently.
Preserve global state across recursive branches and keep intermediate values distinct from final adjustments.
